Dyson has long been known for its incredible vacuums. Before the Airwrap and beauty devices that went viral, the brand was revered for creating some of the most reliable vacuums around. But a reputation like this doesn’t come cheap, so shopping around for deals is always a good idea when looking for a Dyson.

Amazon has dropped the price on a range of Dyson vacuums, from cordless stick vacuums to robot vacuums. We’ve rounded up some of our favorites below.

Best upright vacuum Dyson deal

Credit: Dyson

$314.99 at Amazon
$449.99 Save $135

Why we like it

This Dyson Ball Animal vacuum is perfect for larger homes with pets. It has a powerful suction with Ball technology that makes it easy to maneuver around furniture and obstacles. Its self-adjusting cleaner head, whole-machine filtration, and five included accessories help tackle stubborn dirt, allergens, and pet mess throughout the home.

Best cordless vacuum Dyson deal

Credit: Dyson

$299.99 at Amazon
$389.99 Save $90

Why we like it

The Dyson V8 cordless vacuum is a lightweight option that offers up to 40 minutes of runtime and two cleaning modes. It features a Motorbar cleaner head that can cope with all floor types, plus anti-tangle technology for long and pet hair. It can even convert into a handheld vacuum for cleaning the car or upholstery.
